Five signs your water heater is about to fail

Most tank water heaters last ten to twelve years. Rusty water, rumbling noises, a damp floor around the base, water that runs cold sooner than it used to and a unit older than a decade are all signs it is time to plan a replacement before it fails on its own schedule.

If you spot water pooling around the tank, turn off the supply valve on the cold inlet and call us.
